title: Fair, multilingual assessments, generated for every student.
lead: Gradix turns a short prompt or your teaching material into exams with a unique question set per student, in the language each student prefers.

unique.title: A different question set for every student
unique.text: Questions come from a checked pool built from your material, so no two students get the same paper and answers can't simply be shared.

adaptive.title: Adaptive difficulty
adaptive.text: Questions get harder after strong answers and easier after weak ones, while every student covers the same learning objectives.

languages.title: English, Urdu, Arabic and Persian
languages.text: Each student chooses their language. Questions are written natively in it, with right-to-left layout where needed.

sources.title: Start from a prompt or your files
sources.text: Upload PDF, Word, PowerPoint, text or images (scans are read with OCR), or just describe the topic.

marking.title: Negative marking
marking.text: Set marks for correct answers and deductions for wrong ones per question block. Unanswered questions score zero.

papers.title: Printable papers
papers.text: Download a PDF paper in any supported language with your institute header and an answer key.

fair.title: Fair, timed, one attempt
fair.text: Per-question timers enforced by the server, one attempt per student, and answers saved as you go.
